reviews.title: Kind of cheater airlines No  support No Direct Contact No refund
reviews.text: First traveling mistake of my life to book ticket with NokScoot airlines. its almost 1 year gone I am still waiting for my refund amount. Airlines cancel my flight from their end and never respond on refund. Worst airlines don't book your flight with this airlines. I would recommend you to book flight with Indian company if you are going somewhere from India. NokScoot is a cheater airlines
reviews.author: Naveen Kumar

reviews.title: Be careful cheating airline!!!
reviews.text: Be careful with booking of this airline!!! They offer flights, take the money and later they cancel the flight. After this they offer a voucher but even after one month no feedback or voucher. No answer at any e mails, no feedback. Therefore i warn all people, do not book this airline!!!!!!
reviews.author: Gerhard E

reviews.title: The World's Worst Airline.
reviews.text: Nok Scoot Airlines must rank as the World's Worst Airline - having unilaterally cancelled both outbound and inbound flights, attempting to gain flight credit vouchers or a refund from the so-called support team or call centre has proved impossible over a period exceeding one month. Whilst the airline demands bookings received in cash within 60 minutes in order to confirm - refunds take a mind boggling 14 weeks to process. The CAAT should revoke this carriers certification to operate in Thailand until it administers customers accounts professionally and stops pocketing booking funds making it nigh impossible to recover.
reviews.author: LindaBangkok

reviews.title: Terrible Airline, Terrible Customer Service
reviews.text: We had someone show extremely flu symptoms earlier last week, and talked to the counter about changing to the next flight out which was the next day, as we worried for our health with this passenger. They would not budge and told us we need to call the customer service hotline in order to make any changes. In the time it took me to sit on hold and finally get to someone, the plane closed its check in and I was deemed a no-show in their system. They have a COVID19 policy, but this apparently did not meet their standards and did not allow me to rebook despite their COVID19 policy. Now keep in mind the plane has not left yet. The customer service told me there was nothing they can do and I would have to rebook my flight if I wanted to do anything and no credit would be applied. The next experience was another COVID19 experience where we are flying back from BKK to Osaka, and we wanted to limit our time in Osaka. Their COVID19 policy clearly states that we would pay the difference between the flights if we are changing the dates, no problem. When we look at what we paid for our return flight vs what a new return flight would be, it equals to less than the original return flight cost (I.E. I would not have to pay anything to change the date). I am being told that I would still have to pay over 13800 yen on top of our initial flight costs for some reason. I request a travel voucher instead, and the value is 16800 yen (see how this no longer makes sense anymore? The worth my travel
reviews.author: J D

reviews.title: I wish to give ratings in negative
reviews.text: #useless Flights #TripSpoilers #IrresponsibleStaff #extremelyBadExperience Irresponsible people and staff of Nok Scoot, both domestic and International. The flight was cancelled without any notice and there is no update on refund of the ticket amount even after multiple chasers on almost everywhere on email/phone/social media. Not sure, what kind of service are they providing to their customers and howcome they are even running their business.
reviews.author: yamini

reviews.title: Good bargain airline
reviews.text: We booked this flight through Expedia. No frills business class is what we received! We were given the equivalent of a tv dinner for food. There was zero alcohol on board. We are very frequent fliers of major airlines and always fly business class. We booked a round trip flight but ended up booking business class with a major airline for our return flight. Plane was clean. Flight attendants were professional. But, if you're believing you're getting business class, you're definitely NOT! If you're on a very tight budget, book the economy seats. They don't allow you to bring any food or drinks on board. You're forced to purchase anything you'd like to consume. Booking a 7+ hour flight with zero business class amenities was a HUGE disappointment.
reviews.author: GInnyAlamo

reviews.title: Very Horrible flights
reviews.text: Staff were very rude, did not provide the water when asked for. the meals were not prebooked.I do not recommend this airlines.
reviews.author: Hasan

reviews.title: Rude cabin crew
reviews.text: Really rude cabin crew. Doesn't know how to behave. Don't understand that they not only represent their company, but also are the first look into their country. Hospitality / service sector should have better training and standards.
reviews.author: Prabhjeet S

reviews.title: Worst experience ever
reviews.text: First, I had been waiting in a long line for almost two hours (the longest ever in my life). They just opened 4 counters to check in in spite of the crowd. I understand that it's a low cost airline, so they didn't even provide some drinks on board (including water) to the passengers. The seats seemed a bit old and need a maintenance. The worst experience of all times.
reviews.author: Jackie B

reviews.title: Flight delayed 2days no any help line
reviews.text: Flight delayed 2 days .staff very rude in Delhi airport .i don’t chose agin in life.very poor service.
reviews.author: Preet

reviews.title: Useless company
reviews.text: Flight was delayed, there is no ground staff available who can answer what will be new timings for flight after rescheduling 3 times, ground staff says they don't know anything, people started beating ground staff but in reality these companies put local Indian people in ground team who is to face customer. Customer care is unreachable or try to call Singapore or Bangkok and waste your money over hold. So best practice is to invest more money and avail good carrier always and save money by travelling through public conveyance. If somebody wants to waste hardened earned money please go for this also no cabin baggage.
reviews.author: Gaurav N

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text: They cancelled our flight after 5 hours spending at boarding gate. We sacrificed our sleep and time and wasted money on this flight. XW305 flight worst management
reviews.author: Harsh

reviews.title: Comfortable Seat of Low Cost Airline
reviews.text: Impress the service, this is the first time for sitting more than 4 hours with Low cost Airline. I got a nice seat that i never thought of, Thanks the air ground officer that selected a good seat for me. As a low cost we always concern the leg room for the normal seat that would be uncomfortable, but NokScoot is different, I'm a really tall person 178 cm. it was comfortable seat for me. Cleanness airline and also good food (select your menu on website, price is reasonable) Service on board. I should say Nice, If you are looking for a reasonable price for 4 hours attending the flight. NokScoot from Bkk to Kanzai is a choice for you.
reviews.author: kuniam u

reviews.title: Not pretty bad
reviews.text: I felt the flight to Bangkok from Osaka was totally good, because we can quickly and cheaply access to Bangkok from other countries. Ensuring widely seat pitch was one of good point.But I felt disappointed to hear that you don't have mileage service as Air Asia and Scoot for Krisflyer.
reviews.author: E2762JZ

reviews.title: Cheap and Good
reviews.text: Leg space was good. Flight attendants were polite and the most important flight was clean and on time.
reviews.author: Ruchi_1307

reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE/ CHARGED DOUBLE/ NO REPLY AFTERWARDS
reviews.text: I was travelling back from Thailand in July 2019 with my wife, Booked package through #Make My Trip.COM. A booking ID No. NL2201731870782 & PNR R74Z7M. Luggage was not included. At the time of airport check-in, Staff was very rude, They asked us to pay for 40 KG of luggage where my luggage was the only 18KG. Otherwise, they will not let us travel. So we paid and came back. With extreme disappointment & Disaster experience with NOKSCOOT Airlines & Make my trip services. Till now refund is not processed after asking so many times.
reviews.author: Ankit M

reviews.title: Reluctance
reviews.text: We are very dissapointed about this company. We missed our flight, becouse they dont want to check us one hour before departure. Stevards were very reluctant and arogant. We had to buy new flight tickets from another company, which flight goes 20 minutes later. They checked us and board us in 10 minutes.
reviews.author: Káťa L

reviews.title: This is what I think of NokScoot Buisness class
reviews.text: The Buisness class seats are smaller than the Economy class seats. I am not kidding. I know I am big. That’s why I pay more for bigger Buisness class or same seats with nobody next to me. These ones are smaller and unsafe. I don’t even have a neck rest, no arm rest. This is completely uncomfortable and in case the plane Has an accident unsafe! Report to Thai aviation and Chinese aviation is being placed.
reviews.author: Milano278

reviews.title: Low cost! Fine for short duration flights.
reviews.text: Time: Reached on time. Cost: Good for budgeted traveler but be careful while booking as baggage & food is not included. Entertainment: No source of entertainment. Comfort: The seats were small and not comfortable. The leg space was very less. I am short heighten person but I still faced the issue so tall people keep that in mind. Book Nokscoot plus for more leg space. Food: Food was not great. Water was served in a very small bottle. Announcement was in Thai language so we were not able to understand any instructions. NOTE: If you feel cold in flight, please carry a shirt or shawl as there are no blankets available.
reviews.author: Samyak Jain

reviews.title: Worst Airline I've ever flown with, Asian Ryanair.
reviews.text: Where to start. You cant check in online to start with. For a 6 hr flight there is zero inflight entertainment. No food included or water ( yes you have to buy water!) The seats are cheap and uncomfortable. Our flight was midnight, so was hoping to get some sleep, unfortunately they decided to switch on the lighting after 2hrs so they could serve a handful of people food that had booked it, while everyone else was left to suffer. Got off the flight feeling jet lagged. Business class looked no different from economy class except they kept the lights off. Can honestly say these are the worst ive flown. Stick to Air Asia.
reviews.author: Dave

reviews.title: Just stay away from Nokscoot. Bad customer service. THE WORST COMMUNICATION EVER.
reviews.text: The keep changing the flight to save their cost ( 2 times for my flight) Put customer to have no choice. There is no updated on the flight status on their website and also send me a wrong information.
reviews.author: Phataraphan Phoonsawat

reviews.title: Quality low cost
reviews.text: One good thing for flying low cost for six hours, is no one will bother you for the whole trip, where you can get a full rest. Full service is of course much better, if you fly during daytime. But for late night, I found that I can rest more in low cost.
reviews.author: Tery W

reviews.title: Cheapest flight to Bangkok
reviews.text: As a budget traveler, the experience of flying with Nok Scoot was good. The ticket was economical. They only serve water onboard free of cost. As this is a mid night flight I was happy travelling with them.
reviews.author: Akarsh J

reviews.title: Lack of Customer Service
reviews.text: I booked a roundtrip flight on Nokscoot to Japan, but they canceled the first leg of the flight and were unwilling to cancel the return trip. In order to save my vacation, I had to look for an alternative flight with a different airline. They only offered a refund as a voucher for 120% of the flight of the first leg, no cash reimbursement and no willingness to rebook us on a flight of another airline. When we took the return flight we wanted to manage our booking the website would not allow us to do add services or book seats. The app showed a blank page. We were offered to make the changes upon checkin, but were asked for much higher fees than what it would have been online. The flight itself was smooth. The aircraft was fine. For a flight over 6 hours we weren't even offered a free glass of water.
reviews.author: Micha Doy

reviews.title: 4 hr. 40 mins. delay just only McDonald's set treat No Notification, Couldn't check any update... poor
reviews.text: เครื่องออก 02:20am. ไปถึง 23:00pm. เจอป้าย delay เป็น 07:00am. โดยไม่มีการส่งข้อความแจ้งเตือนการดีเลย์ใดๆทั้ง SMS หรือ email ขอโทษด้วยการให้อาหารชุดแมคโดนัลด์ 2 ชุด ไม่สามารถรับฝากกระเป๋าเดินทางได้ ไม่สามารถออก boarding pass เลยไม่สามารถเข้าไปรอที่ lounge ได้ ตัดสินใจเรียก grab กลับบ้าน ระหว่างทางพยายามติดต่อกับทางเจ้าหน้าที่สายการบินโดยเริ่มจากโหลด application ของสายการบินแต่ก็ out of date ไปหลายปีแล้วข้อมูลต่างๆไม่ realtime โทรศัพท์หาเจ้าหน้าที่ก็เป็นเวลาปิดทำการ แต่สามารถคุยภาษาอังกฤษหรือจีนกับเจ้าหน้าที่ได้ สุดท้ายได้คุยแต่ไม่สามารถตรวจสอบอะไรได้เลย ขอบคุณเจ้าหน้าที่ประชาสัมพันธ์ของสนามบินดอนเมืองที่ตรวจสอบต่างๆให้เรียบร้อย 7 โมงเช้ากลับไปที่สนามบินอีกรอบทุกอย่างราบรื่นอย่างที่ควรจะเป็น เครื่องบินสะอาดเรียบร้อย บริการดี เครื่องบินดีเลย์สามารถรับได้แต่ควรจะใช้ technology ให้เป็นประโยชน์มีการเตือนผู้โดยสารทันทีที่ทราบว่าเครื่องดีเลย์ และให้ผู้โดยสารสามารถตรวจสอบรายละเอียดต่างๆแบบ realtime ได้ด้วย การบริการของพนักงานมาตรฐานที่ดีแต่จะไม่ใช้บริการสายบินนี้อีกถ้าไม่จำเป็นจริงๆ ก็เพราะระบบการบริหารจัดการที่ไม่มีประสิทธิภาพ
reviews.author: Noppadol P

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Check in staff was nice however the luggage charges were bogus. In flight staff was rude and pestering. People were packed in like sardines. Just an awful experience don’t book through them!
reviews.author: Zeus

reviews.title: Very good aircraft
reviews.text: Flight was on time. Check in was smooth. Cabin crew were young. Leg space in economy class was not enough for me as I am 6 feet in height. Food was not complementary. There were very few options for vegetarians. Overall experience is good.
reviews.author: Parvesh V

reviews.title: Flight departs on time
reviews.text: Following a 3 hour delay on Nokscoot from Bangkok to Osaka on 18 July, I'm happy to report that the return flight from Osaka to Don Mueang on 27 July departed on time. Seats in the extra leg-room zone (silent zone) are fantastic and beat all economy seats on mainline carriers that I've been on. The plane was probably 30 % full so there was plenty of space to stretch out. Staff were quick to get people to buckle up when the seat-belt sign was on. Overall a good flight experience.
reviews.author: Rory T

reviews.title: Delayed flight.
reviews.text: There was No mention of the delayed flight to Osaka tonight when I checked in which really doesn't reflect well on this airline. The flight has been delayed for 3 hours and there's been no communication by airline staff to the best of my knowledge. Hopefully this won't happen on the return flight!
reviews.author: Rory T
